lines.text: Job says his grief outweighs the sand of the seas, and the arrows of the Almighty have pierced him.
Job says his brothers are faithless like wadis, and caravans of Tema and Sheba look for water.
Job says he asked his friends for a bribe, and he asks them to teach him how he has erred.

wrong_details.wrong: he asked his friends for a bribe
wrong_details.true: Job never asked his friends for a bribe from their wealth

lines.text: Job says he is allotted months of futility and nights of misery, and he counts the stars until dawn.
Job asks God why he is under guard, and says God has made him His target.
